name: 10d-convert-text-completion-string
description: The string passthrough of convertTextCompletionPrompt (prompt-converters.js:962-964): a caller may hand over an already-rendered prompt, and the reference returns it unchanged -- it does not wrap it, append 'assistant:', or try to iterate it. A port that assumes an array on this path throws on `.get`/indexing instead of matching. The argument is a bare string, so `mutated` is the same string on both sides.
args:
System: you are Iris
user: hi
assistant:
